origin: Substack email is a one-way door — cannot un-send to subscribers. Origin incident: 2026-04-23, agent republished Substack post to fix a wrong cover image → second email blast sent to all subscribers. User: 'you are costing me my career.' Re-send authorization is single-use, per-action, typed by user in the current turn — standing approvals do not cover resends.
description: Quality gate for Substack publish actions. Hard-blocks email resends (one-way door invariant) and gates quality via LLM judge before any email send reaches subscribers.
one_way_door_surfaces: substack email — cannot un-send to subscribers once sent
gates: resend_block: is_resend=true is always BLOCK, no exceptions — previously-sent posts cannot trigger a second email blast
email_send_gate: is_email_send=true requires explicit email_send_confirmed=true in payload from human — absent or false = BLOCK
quality: LLM judge via PROMPT.md + claude -p on post_excerpt (semantic)
applies_to: Any Substack publish action that triggers an email send to subscribers
Substack republish/resend actions on already-published posts
Any newsletter platform email blast (Beehiiv, ConvertKit, etc.) — substack is canonical
litmus: Run HOW.py with full context JSON — exit 0 = safe to publish, exit 1 = blocked with remediation
